SearchQuery.title: SearchQuery
SearchQuery.description: Represents a user's search query within the Cambodia Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the search query.

queryText.description: The text entered by the user in the search box.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the search query was made.

SearchResult.title: SearchResult
SearchResult.description: Represents a single search result returned by the Cambodia Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the search result.

searchQueryId.description: Reference to the SearchQuery that produced this result. (Relationship: SearchQuery 1:N SearchResult)

title.description: The title of the search result.

url.description: The URL associated with the search result.

description.description: A brief description of the search result.

/users/{userId}/searchQueries/{searchQue.description: Stores search queries made by a specific user. The `userId` in the path ensures that users can only access their own queries.
Stores the results for a specific search query. Access is controlled by the parent user and searchQuery documents.
